title: Fastest-convergence conjecture for the complementing flip process
statement:
Let $\mathcal{R}$ be a convergent flip process of order $k$ with a single destination. For $\delta\in(0,\frac{1}{2})$, let $\tau_{\mathcal{R}}^-(\delta)$ denote its lower convergence time.

**Fastest-convergence conjecture.** For every such $\mathcal{R}$ and every $\delta\in(0,\frac{1}{2})$,

$$
\tau_{\mathcal{R}}^-(\delta)\ge \frac{-\ln(2\delta)}{2(k)_2}.
$$

The bound is attained by the complementing flip process, whose convergence time is described in the source as half that of an ignorant process with output density $1/2$. The source does not state whether the conjecture has been resolved.
source_name: Pedro Araújo, Jan Hladký, Eng Keat Hng and Matas Šileikis, “Prominent examples of flip processes”, arXiv:2206.03884 (2022).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.03884

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of June 2022).
